messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Basaglar manufactured by: Eli Lilly and Company, Indianapolis, IN 46285 USA.
Lantus manufactured by: sanofi-aventis U.S. LLC, Bridgewater, NJ 08807, A SANOFI COMPANY.
Langlara manufactured by: Sunshine Lake Pharma, China; sanofi-aventis U.S. LLC's U.S. distributor is Lanexa Biologics/Lannett.
Rezvoglar manufactured by: Eli Lilly and Company, Indianapolis, IN 46285, USA.
Semglee manufactured by: Biocon Biologics Inc. 245 Main St, 2nd Floor, Cambridge, MA 02142 USA.
Toujeo manufactured by: sanofi-aventis U.S. LLC, Bridgewater, NJ 08807, A SANOFI COMPANY.
Triplet: ["Lantus", "manufacturer parent company", "A SANOFI COMPANY"]

The relation 'manufacturer parent company' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject company is a subsidiary or part of the larger corporate entity specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
B. 'is type of': The subject entity is a specific type or category of the object entity.
C. 'include': The object entity is an example or member of the subject entity.
D. 'is one of most widely prescribed': The subject entity is among the most widely prescribed entities of the type specified by the object entity.
E. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
